name: Donorbox
description: Donorbox is a fundraising platform for donation forms, campaigns, recurring giving, donor management, events, memberships and nonprofit integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Donorbox API key and organization email, then list one bounded page of campaign identity metadata without donor, donation, plan or financial data.

credentialRequirements.name: DONORBOX_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
credentialRequirements.label: Donorbox organization login email
credentialRequirements.helpText: The organization login email used as the Basic Auth username.

credentialRequirements.name: DONORBOX_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Donorbox API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the customer-owned key under Account Settings > API & Zapier Integration and store it encrypted.

capabilities.label: Read campaign metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Donorbox campaign identity metadata without donor, donation, plan or financial fields.

allowed.label: List campaigns
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Donorbox campaign identity summaries from page one.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Donors, donations, plans, names, emails, addresses, employment, comments, payment methods, amounts, goals, totals and donation counts are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block fundraising mutations
blocked.description: Campaign, donation, plan, donor, account and every other mutation are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary filters, endpoints, automatic pagination, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Only bounded campaign identity metadata reads run directly; people, financial, mutation, pagination and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read runs without Relay per-action approval; account authority, fixed origin, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one typed campaign-identity read and sends Basic Auth only to the fixed Donorbox origin.
Relay mounts one typed campaign-identity read and sends Basic Auth only to the fixed Donorbox origin.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer enables API & Zapier Integration, generates its API key, enters it with the organization login email, then selects campaign-read capability and policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Donorbox documents organization-email plus API-key Basic Auth, fixed HTTPS endpoints, campaign/donation/plan/donor resources, page and per_page controls capped at 100, ordering, filters and 60 requests per minute.
Donorbox documents customer API-key generation from the account's API & Zapier Integration settings.
Donorbox's official integrations page identifies Zapier and API access as supported integration paths for campaign, donation and supporter data.
